text:
deploy-bot: Starting promotion of release v2.7.1-rc3 -> staging

deploy-bot: Running preflight checks: unit tests ✅, e2e ✅, prompt-evals: 1 failed (gating)

eval-bot: Prompt-eval summary for model my-chat-model@v2.7.1-rc3
- Critical eval set (payment-flows): pass_rate 92.1% (threshold 95%)
- Noncritical sets: minor regressions but within tolerance
- Example failure (truncated):
```
Input: "refund status for order #12345"
Expected: "Your refund is processed and will appear in 3-5 business days"
Model: "Refund may take several weeks. Contact support."
```

dave: oof, that's a pretty big regression on payments.

alice: is this new for rc3 or was it present in rc2?

eval-bot: rc2 (v2.7.1-rc2) pass_rate on that set was 96.3% — regression introduced in rc3

carol: tagging @alice @dave — we need a quick triage. Release is blocked by eval gate.

ben: we have two options: 1) revert model binary -> pin to last stable my-chat-model@v2.7.0 for staging, 2) approve a gated rollout with strict canary and manual QA. Thoughts?

alice: I want to run a minimal bisect on the commit range — might be a tokenization/quantization change. Give me 30m.

emily: if pinning is fast we should do that to keep other teams testing. pinning command:
```
redwoodctl runtime pin-model --name my-chat-model --version v2.7.0 --route staging
```

ben: agree. do the pin first, then alice bisects on a branch. can we do the pin now?

deploy-bot: Action: hold promotion. Promotion paused by eval-gate at 1763500000.

carol: I'll document in release notes and schedule a hotfix window for tomorrow 09:00 PT if needed.

alice: started bisect. found candidate commit 1f7a9 -> introduced quant flag default change. running eval on that commit now.

eval-bot: quick re-eval on 1f7a9 shows pass_rate 93.0% — still failing but points to quantization path.

dave: if quantization path is root cause, we can revert the flag or add model-specific override. Which is faster?

alice: revert flag in rc3 branch, run prompt-evals. If green, we can re-promote the rc3 binary.

emily: ben, can you approve temporary pin and note in release notes that staging uses v2.7.0 until rc3 is fixed? Need a :thumbsup: from release owner.

ben: +1. Pin away. Also add rollback instructions in notes:
```
# rollback steps
redwoodctl runtime pin-model --name my-chat-model --version v2.7.0 --route staging
# to unpin
redwoodctl runtime unpin-model --route staging
```

carol: added to release notes and change window. tagging @support for heads-up.

support-bot: Notified #support with message: "Staging pinned to my-chat-model@v2.7.0 due to prompt-eval regression. Expect re-evaluation tomorrow."

alice: will post results here when bisect finishes.

emily: thanks everyone. keeping gate open until eval-bot reports green on rc3.

ben: leaving this thread open — move to postmortem if we need a retro.

alice: bisect complete, root cause confirmed. PR incoming to revert quant flag and add a test against the payment eval set.

eval-bot: Re-eval of rc3 after revert (my-chat-model@v2.7.1-rc3-fix): pass_rate 95.4% — gate passed.

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed. rc3 promoted to staging at 1763500260

ben: thanks. unpinning in 10m after smoke tests.

emily: noted for release notes: "Fixed quantization flag regression affecting payment responses; gated promotion after prompt-eval failure; staging temporarily pinned to v2.7.0."

carol: closing thread once unpin done.

support-bot: Support notified of promotion resume.
